turns.assessment: The simultaneous loss of multiple optical channels at receivers in both S15 and S04 is the signature of a bidirectional physical interruption on the S15–S04 cable. It explains the broad service impact and the SNCP switches, while unchanged amplifier pump/power telemetry argues against an amplifier failure. The evidence does not identify the particular fibre span, so no element-specific repair can be committed safely.

proposals.rationale: O14–O23 show simultaneous OCH loss at both ends of the S15–S04 route, followed by lost receiver power and loss of multiple channels at the S04 monitor on the line from S15. A cable cut normally interrupts both fibres and therefore accounts for the reciprocal, multi-channel failure. Unchanged amplifier telemetry makes an amplifier pump failure unlikely, but the observations do not isolate which span was cut.
